summary: The Educational Technology and Digital Safety Lead at Assabet Valley Collaborative opposes imposing screen-time limits on E-Rate decisions, arguing that such restrictions could impose additional costs on schools and limit access to essential communication and instructional tools for students with disabilities.

claims.argument: Screen-time limits could impose additional costs on schools
claims.evidence_quote: Please preserve E-Rate and support student safety through approaches that allow schools to make thoughtful decisions based on students’ ages, educational goals, and individualized needs.
